t: 2030 — First archive hulls systems operational: deep storage detection
title: 2030 — First archive hulls systems operational: deep storage detection
definition: 2030 milestone on the Digital Vault Archives roadmap.
description:
First archive hulls systems operational: deep storage detection networks live on every continent.

What must be true first: the deep storage results have to replicate outside the lab, archive logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and format migration operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed deep storage demonstrations, archive logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting format migration uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Digital Vault Archives
definition: Estimates Digital Vault Archives readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Digital Vault Archives components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a archive hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Digital Vault Archives Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Digital Vault Archives operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Digital Vault Archives installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 14525 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where deep storage monitoring, archive logistics redundancy, or format migration maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Digital Vault Archives Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Digital Vault Archives: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Digital Vault Archives — vaults preserving digital civilization.

Phase 1 — Prove (deep storage): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (archive logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (format migration): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (access protocols): archive hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and heritage-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
